report.headline: Five new Houston-area construction sites within reach of your yard.
report.supportingCopy: EXAMPLE FORMAT. Replace with the hauler's name and its own five sites. Each site comes from a TCEQ construction stormwater record, read for hauling scope and a real contact.
report.reportIdentifier: EXAMPLE SAMPLE REPORT, NOT FOR SENDING

projects.name: Central Office Annex
projects.whatsFiled: Construction stormwater authorization for an industrial site, operator on file Nupi Americas Inc. The record lists no project value or finish date.
projects.likelyScope: Roll-off containers for construction debris on an industrial site; our read from the site type, not the filing.
projects.whoDecides: Operator on file is Nupi Americas Inc, a routing contact, not confirmed as the hauling decision-maker. No hauler is named in the record, which is not the same as no hauler chosen.
projects.contactLine: Operator on file: Nupi Americas Inc (business name from the TCEQ record)
projects.firstStep: Call the operator's main office and ask who books site services for this job.

pilot.headline: How this list was built.
bullets: Five sites pulled from TCEQ construction stormwater records, each with its own authorization number.
Distances and hauling scope are our read of the public record, not confirmation that work has started or that a hauler is unselected.
No individual names; every contact is a business name on file.
pilot.disclosure: A stormwater authorization shows a site is permitted for construction; it does not say who hauls for it.
